blocks.text: Acme builds the platform teams use to ship and run their applications worldwide. We are a small team with a big footprint, and we care about tools that get out of the way.
As a Senior Platform Engineer you will turn quality into a built-in capability of our engineering platform: automation, internal tools and standards that remove manual steps from the delivery cycle.
You will work with the development, platform and infrastructure teams on self-service tools, standard pipelines and automated release checks.

items: Build and evolve standard CI/CD pipelines for tests, checks and releases.
Write internal frameworks and tools for test automation.
Automate functional, integration and end-to-end tests.
Guide engineers in testing and automation practices.
Experience with test automation and quality engineering.
Solid experience with CI/CD and pipeline automation.
Tooling written in TypeScript, Python or Go.
Working knowledge of Linux and containers.
